@returns The address of the sender of the last message that [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) received.
@param udp_stream  The stream.
@gap A sender that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetUDPMsgAddress](GetUDPMsgAddress). IPv4 senders are not changed.
